title: Make Places narrator headings consistently name the parent location
body:
## Problem

The Places narrator's white heading was always `zoneName`, so the header duplicated the yellow label for zone, city and continent recordings. It only happened to be correct for subzones.

## Change

- Use `SSZLoreWindow.PlaceAbove(mapID)` and `SSZLoreWindow.ZoneName(parentID)`, the same **existing** static hierarchy and labels that the Places Compendium uses on the 1.12 client.
- **Subzones:** white = containing zone, yellow = subzone.
- **Cities:** white = containing zone, yellow = city.
- **Zones:** white = continent, yellow = zone.
- **Continents:** white = Azeroth, yellow = continent.
- **Azeroth:** white = Azeroth, yellow = Azeroth, deliberately, until we choose a better world-root title.
- A missing/failed Compendium UI helper gracefully falls back to the old zone name rather than interrupting any audio. No changes to clips, pack priority, queue, portrait, player layout or Compendium.

## Regression coverage

`tests/places_zone_portrait_emblems.lua` now uses the real Compendium map tables and real `SSZLoreWindow` parent resolver and tests Durotar/Valley of Trials, Darnassus/Teldrassil/Kalimdor/Azeroth, original yellow labels, and fail-safe behavior when the UI helper is missing or raises.

## In-game verification

Replay `Craftsmen's Terrace`, `Darnassus`, `Teldrassil`, `Kalimdor` and `Azeroth` from Places; compare white headings with the screenshot examples. The text and portraits should be otherwise unchanged.

title: Support both ClassicAPI creature portrait model implementations
body:
## Places narrator portraits: zone emblems (additional change)

- Restores upstream Spoken's **zone emblem** in the compact Places narration portrait, instead of repurposing a scenic Compendium illustration.
- Zone and subzone narration share the zone's icon; cities, Moonglade and battlegrounds have their own upstream emblems; an unmapped map can inherit its parent via `Spoken:ZoneIcon`, or fall back to the bundled book texture if no icon can be found.
- Expands `SoftSpoken/API.lua`'s `ZONE_ICONS` map to upstream's complete **57** badges. The repository already contained 47 identical upstream assets; added the 10 missing city/battleground/Moonglade `.tga` files with SHA verification against upstream commit `59a3445d`.
- Keeps Places' scenic illustrations in the Compendium (`SSZPicturesUI`), without cropping a landscape into the round narrator face. No audio pack, queue, map highlights or Compendium layout changes.
- Adds `SoftSpoken/Textures/Zones/SOURCE.md` with attribution, plus `tests/places_zone_portrait_emblems.lua` and CI validation of the 57 packaged icon files and narration fallbacks.
- The temporary binary import workflow was **removed** after it committed the verified assets; no scheduled import or new runtime network dependency remains.

**In-game verification:** play any zone and subzone (e.g., Durotar and Valley of Trials), then a capital (e.g., Darnassus) and a zone with no icon. Both zone and subzone should display the same emblem; a capital should use its own; scenic pictures should remain visible in the Places Compendium. Check the circular crop and the Azeroth globe, which uses whole UVs.

## Why

ClassicAPI's October 19, 2026 model update moved `SetDisplayInfo` and `SetCreature` from `Model` to `PlayerModel`, with native camera, light, skins and `SetPortraitZoom`. SoftSpoken's optional NPC renderer still assumed a plain `Model` with manual lighting, which cannot display portraits using the updated API.

## Changes

- Keep the existing `kind="creature"` presentation contract, quest speaker lookup, legacy `kind="model"` fallback and audio queue untouched.
- Detect actual frame methods at runtime rather than DLL version strings. Prefer `PlayerModel:SetDisplayInfo` when supported; otherwise select the original `Model:SetDisplayInfo`.
- Use native `PlayerModel:SetPortraitZoom(1)` when available; retain manual `Model:SetCamera(0)` and lighting for older ClassicAPI.
- Assign IDs before making an NPC visible; hide and clear the prior speaker on changes, and refresh native display records on reuse. Never depend on `GetModel()` immediately returning a path on the new asynchronous `PlayerModel`.
- Keep the original Vanilla model path available when no ClassicAPI creature ID can be resolved, and preserve the original non-creature item/object artwork.
- **New:** use the exact faction crest already shown on the Stories Compendium as the final fallback for NPC portraits instead of the book icon; once a ClassicAPI creature ID resolves, a failed enhanced portrait falls directly to the crest rather than an old NPC model.
- Retain *all* creature cache completions within one update tick instead of overwriting a single `refreshID`; only refresh the current speaking NPC without touching narration state.
- Add `tests/classicapi_portrait_compatibility.lua` and execute it in GitHub Actions alongside existing audio checks.

### Shared player-faction crest (additional pre-merge polish)

- Added `SoftSpoken_Stories/FactionCrest.lua`, loaded before `Player.lua` and `Compendium/QuestPage_112.lua`. Both callers invoke `SSCQuestFactionCrest.Resolve()`, so Alliance/Horde artwork and faction/race detection cannot drift apart.
- Uses the existing 256├ù256 transparent `Assets/AllianceCrest.tga` and `Assets/HordeCrest.tga`, with **full (0,1,0,1) texture coordinates** (no icon cropping).
- Keeps the exact Compendium priority of `UnitFactionGroup("player")` and legacy `UnitRace("player")`, including Turtle races. Unknown faction retains the Compendium's existing book icon.
- Quest objects/items still show their actual item icon or note, not a faction crest.
- Adds `tests/stories_faction_crest.lua` to CI to verify faction selection, nonlocalized race fallback, replay/live-NPC/legacy fallback, and shared Compendium wiring.

### Automated verification

Run `lua5.1 tests/classicapi_portrait_compatibility.lua` and `lua5.1 tests/stories_faction_crest.lua` to exercise the real portrait module against mocked **older API**, **updated API**, and **no API** frames, including stale model replacement, async cache event coalescing, optional-disable fallback and deferred modern appearance loading.

This is a simulation, **not proof of in-game rendering on a particular ClassicAPI release**.

### Turtle WoW / real-ClassicAPI checks before merging

1. With older ClassicAPI: start live NPC dialogue and quest-log replay, verify NPC is framed and lit using `Model`.
2. With newer ClassicAPI (v1.18+): repeat with `PlayerModel`; verify native head/shoulders camera, textures and equipment, no black portrait.
3. Repeat with an uncached NPC/quest giver and observe texture fallback followed by a model when the cache data arrives.
4. Switch rapidly among speaking NPCs; verify no stale faces or old models remain.
5. Hide/show player, pause/resume, play a quest object/item and switch back to a creature, including the same creature after a different one.
6. Run `/run SoftSpokenClassicPortraits=false` then repeat a dialogue: if no live model is available, it must show your faction crest. Restore with `/run SoftSpokenClassicPortraits=nil` and reload to reenable.
7. Test **both an Alliance and a Horde character**: the audio-player fallback must show the same crest as Stories' Compendium, uncropped, in quest-log replay and when a model can't load; verify objects/items keep their own icons.
8. Check there is no change to playback, queue, quest lookup or Compendium behavior.

**Scope:** Optional NPC portrait rendering only; no 3D book/game-object rendering and no changes to public data packs. Keep draft until both ClassicAPI versions have been tested in game.

title: Fix World Map lore text overflowing its parchment on WoW 1.12
body:
## Problem
On Turtle WoW 1.12, long Zone Lore text in the World Map's attached panel renders past the bottom of the parchment/frame. A manual `page:Resize(true)` and `UpdateScrollChildRect()` did not resolve it.

## Suspected root cause
The shared `TextView:Reflow()` calls `FontString:GetStringHeight()` unconditionally. That API was introduced in WoW 2.3, so a native 1.12 client may error before the scroll child's height and range are updated. The same post-1.12 method is used when measuring wrapped map-panel subtitles.

## Changes
- Prefer `GetStringHeight` where available and otherwise measure the auto-sized text with `GetHeight` (1.12-compatible).
- Refresh the scroll child's rectangle after setting its height and before restoring the scroll offset.
- Give only the standalone/map subtitle an auto-height font string and measure its wrapped height without requiring a 2.3 API.
- No changes to map geometry, skins, lore data, discovery, or audio.

## Live verification required
1. Pull/checkout this branch, `/reload`, open World Map > Zone Lore > Darnassus.
2. Confirm long text is clipped at the parchment bottom and can be revealed by scrolling instead of spilling onto the world.
3. Check other long zone and subzone entries; scroll to bottom and back; change maps; resize/switch fullscreen/windowed map if supported.
4. Check that the same text reader inside Azeroth's Compendium still scrolls properly and the breadcrumb remains positioned above the divider.

The patch has been source-reviewed only; in-game verification is outstanding.

body:
## Summary

Consolidates SoftSpoken's 1.12-facing command and settings surfaces without yet retiring the legacy Quests AceGUI fallback.

This PR combines the completed **cleanup Phases 1, 2, and 4**. **Phase 3 is intentionally deferred.** It is not a feature-complete unified-settings release.

### Phase 1 ΓÇö only two public commands
- `/spoken` opens/toggles unified Settings (no longer toggles playback).
- `/compendium` opens/toggles the shared Compendium.
- Removes public aliases/subcommands `/sp`, `/spq`, `/spokenquests`, `/spqread`, `/ssb`, `/ssz` and the old `/spoken ...` command dispatcher.
- Redirects Play/Pause, Skip, Stop All, and Compendium keybindings directly to the player API, so playback controls no longer depend on slash dispatch.
- Keeps minimap Settings and Compendium actions; Compendium entry points use the same guarded API.

### Phase 2 ΓÇö canonical settings routing
- Removes pending/dynamic standalone settings-link UI and redundant Quests settings-link registration.
- Uses the unified Home / Quests / Books / Zones page registration as the normal route.
- Keeps a harmless `Spoken:AddSettingsLink` compatibility shim for external callers.

### Phase 4 ΓÇö no diagnostic spam in chat
- Adds a read-only, scrollable/copyable diagnostic report window for Quests and Books.
- Diagnostic generators return lines internally; Quests developer collector no longer temporarily overrides `print`.
- Removes the unreachable `/spq followup` simulation helper and command-only labels (real NPC/quest follow-up handlers remain).
- Updates help/messages mentioning retired commands and displays the Books pack download address in a copyable window.

## Scope and deliberate exclusions
- **No Phase 3:** the old Quests AceGUI fallback, AceConfig/AceGUI libraries, and pack-management internals are retained. Do not delete them in this PR.
- SavedVariables, quest/book/zone discovery logic, sound pack registration and actual narration event handlers are intended to remain unchanged.
- The shared settings UI is unfinished; this is *cleanup*, not a full behavior release.

## Synchronized with current `main`

The cleanup branch was updated via merge commit [`abbb13d`](https://github.com/z1xel/SoftSpoken/commit/abbb13d6b434eebf88daa6556db048b655004372), incorporating all **three** upstream commits that landed after the cleanup work began:
- #14 ΓÇö centralized missing voice-pack notification (retained, including removal of the old Quests popup).
- Quests addon-list metadata fix (retained).
- #15 ΓÇö hide/retarget Compendium tabs when modules are disabled (retained).

At synchronization commit [`abbb13d`](https://github.com/z1xel/SoftSpoken/commit/abbb13d6b434eebf88daa6556db048b655004372), the branch had caught up with `main` at `29200e1`. **Since then, `main` advanced by one unrelated commit** (`3463a4b`, transparent Horde crest in the Quests Compendium) touching only `SoftSpoken_Quests/Assets/HordeCrest.tga` and `SoftSpoken_Quests/Compendium/QuestPage_112.lua`. These do not overlap the cleanup changes, and GitHub reports this PR **cleanly mergeable**. The five feature commits are preserved; the sixth commit synchronized earlier `main` work. The obsolete edit to the removed Quests popup's wording was intentionally dropped rather than resurrecting that popup.

## In-game verification ΓÇö NOT PERFORMED

- [x] Cold-login and `/reload` on Turtle WoW 1.12 with Quests, Books and Zones; no Lua errors.
- [x] `/spoken` opens/toggles Settings; `/compendium` opens/toggles Compendium.
- [x] Retired aliases and command subcommands no longer perform actions.
- [x] Play/Pause, Stop All, Skip and Compendium keybindings still function; Compendium default J behavior is unchanged.
- [x] Minimap left/middle/right click mappings and context menu work.
- [x] Quests/Books/Zones tabs open normally without duplicate settings links.
- [x] Quest/gossip/book/zone audio, installed pack enumeration, and real quest follow-up playback still work.
- [ ] Quests Diagnostics and Books Diagnostics open and copy correctly (especially long reports and scroll).
- [x] Test Voice Line still plays; missing pack notifications still appear correctly.
- [x] Disabling modules hides Compendium tabs as in #15; no reintroduced tabs after reload.
- [ ] Legacy Quests AceGUI fallback remains available when shared page setup fails.
- [x] Existing settings and histories survive `/reload` and character switch.

### Merge gate
**Do not merge solely on static checks.** No WoW client test or CI validation has been performed for this branch. GitHub currently reports a clean merge into `main`; recheck against the newest head and run the unperformed in-game tests before integration.

- Added **Open Azeroth's Compendium** to `SoftSpoken/Bindings.xml` and the Home **Keys** list. The binding uses `/spoken compendium` and the same Compendium action as the minimap button.
- On first initialization, assign **J** if it is unbound and no other key is already assigned to this Compendium action. Do not replace an existing WoW/addon J binding. Store a one-time account-wide seed marker so manually clearing/rebinding the shortcut will not restore J every reload.

- Fixed the reported `SoftSpoken/UI/MinimapButton.lua:155: attempt to index a nil value`: 1.12's UIDropDownMenu callbacks must capture a stable per-menu-entry variable instead of the generic `for` loop variable.
- Fixed the same Lua 5.0 closure bug in `SpokenLayout:Dropdown` affecting click-mapping choices: selecting an item could write `nil` instead of that command. Shared layout version is now 68.

- Minimap mouse-button assignments now offer only **Open Settings**, **Open Compendium**, **Open Menu**. Retired Play / Pause and Stop Reading choices are no longer in the settings dropdown. Existing Stop or Replay / Stop All entries in the contextual minimap menu are untouched.
- Existing profiles with `PlayPause`, `Stop`, or a blank mouse assignment are migrated on read to Left=Settings, Middle=Compendium, Right=Menu. The same command reader is used by the settings dropdown and click dispatcher.

- The earlier adaptive-label fix chose `GameFontNormalSmall` per row, causing visibly inconsistent text sizes across Sound, Minimap, and other sections. This is corrected: every ordinary setting label now uses `GameFontNormal`, without conditional font shrinking.

title: Integrate QuestData and QuestText into SoftSpoken_Quests
body:
## Summary
- Move the original quest catalog and quest dialogue datasets into `SoftSpoken_Quests/Data/`, preserving both Git blob SHAs exactly (no database edits).
- Include the datasets through `addon.xml` before the Compendium UI scripts.
- Remove `LoadAddOn("SoftSpoken_QuestData")` and `LoadAddOn("SoftSpoken_QuestText")` in favor of normal startup loading.
- Remove the two obsolete companion `.toc` files and document the unified layout.

## Verification
- GitHub recognizes both database moves as exact **renames, 0 additions/deletions**.
- Checked `addon.xml` ordering and the removed companion folder paths.
- No overlap with the newer `main` commit that edited `SoftSpoken/Compat.lua`, `SoftSpoken_Quests/Compatibility.lua`, and `SoftSpoken_Quests/Version.lua`.
- **Not yet tested inside Turtle WoW 1.12.** Please keep this PR in draft until in-game validation.

## Manual test plan
1. Check out this branch in the local SoftSpoken repository, with Turtle WoW's four SoftSpoken addon junctions pointing at it.
2. Remove the obsolete `SoftSpoken_QuestData` and `SoftSpoken_QuestText` junctions from `Interface/AddOns` (do not delete the corresponding repository data).
3. Start the client; ensure Quests, gossip and player initialize without Lua errors.
4. Open the Quests Compendium; test categories, filters, counts, chains, discovered/completed states.
5. Open a quest and verify description, progress, and completion text, plus narration/playback where voice packs are installed.
6. Repeat with no audio packs enabled to ensure the Quest Compendium still works.

**Expected tradeoff:** the two static databases now load at startup instead of upon opening their respective Compendium views.

title: Centralize Compendium and language infrastructure; clean legacy code
body:
## Changes
- Centralize Places, Books and Quests parchment/inset and scrollbar construction in the core's `Compendium/UI/PagePane.lua`. Original frame offsets and per-tab page state preserved.
- Store shared Compendium window geometry in core per-character settings; lazily migrate width/height from prior module-owned storage.
- Correct outdated `SpokenCompendium` references in core options and Quest source UI updates.
- Remove inactive legacy Zones UI/captions, old Books commands and dormant core code.
- Add architecture/data-flow documentation.

## Quests loading regression repair
- **Fix addon discovery:** `SoftSpoken_Quests/` previously contained `Spoken_Quests.toc`, which did not match the directory name required by WoW's legacy addon scanner. It is now named `SoftSpoken_Quests.toc`.
- **Restore local libraries:** revert the initial removal of Quests' LibStub, CallbackHandler, AceCore, AceDB and AceTimer files and original `embeds.xml`. Library deduplication is postponed to a separate, independently tested refactor.
- The Quests TOC's `## Dependencies: SoftSpoken` remains unchanged.
- All Quests TOC and nested XML references now resolve to files that exist in the branch.

## Static checks
- Checked manifest load order, shared PagePane references across three modules and original UI placement offsets.
- Checked Quests' corrected TOC name and every direct manifest file path.
- **Turtle WoW 1.12 runtime tests have not yet been performed by the assistant.**

## In-game regression checklist
- [x] Verify SoftSpoken_Quests appears in the character-select AddOns list when installed as `Interface/AddOns/SoftSpoken_Quests/`.
- [x] Verify the Quests and Gossip source registration and Quests Compendium tab.
- [x] Verify Quests audio packs and optional `SoftSpoken_QuestData` companion if installed.
- [x] Core + Zones: explore, autoplay and use Places tab.
- [x] Core + Books: read physical pages and browse Books tab.
- [x] Switch all tabs, resize window and reload; compare to approved geometry.

**Keep draft until the corrected Quests addon has been tested in the client.**

## Follow-up commit: shared language and voice-state coherence
- Move the eleven supported voice languages, client locale rules, and voice/fallback resolution into `SoftSpoken/Language.lua` (`Spoken.Language`).
- Keep Books and Quests' established `Language` method names through small adapters, preserving existing SavedVariables and old English-pack fallbacks.
- Route core language selections through `Spoken:SetLanguageChoice`, emitting `VOICE_LANGUAGE_CHANGED`, including when AceDB switches a whole profile.
- Use `Spoken:NotifyVoicePacksChanged()` instead of directly reaching into `SpokenEnv.Callbacks` from Quests.
- Invalidate the Quests Compendium's `Voiced Only` result cache after deferred/manual pack loads, shared language changes, and quest profile switches.
- Skip the Zones play-button polling loop on current core builds; retain the 0.5-second fallback when `Spoken:RegisterCallback` isn't available.

### Additional static checks
- Confirmed all core XML dependencies resolve and shared language loads before the core settings UI.
- Confirmed one authoritative language list and preserved adapter method names.
- Verified notification paths and the old-client poll fallback.
- In-game validation still needed, especially non-English/fallback selection and newly loaded Quest audio packs.
